question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Destitute
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"destitute"** means lacking the basic necessities of life, such as food, shelter, and clothing. (निर्धन)

 
 
• **Example: **Many **destitute** families were forced to live on the streets after the economic downturn.
 
 
 
• **"Broke"** refers to being without money, financially ruined, or bankrupt. (कंगाल)
 
 
• **Example: **After losing his job, he found himself completely **broke** and in need of financial assistance.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'destitute'** is **'broke'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Broken** (टूटा हुआ): Having been fractured or damaged and no longer in one piece or in working order.

 
 
• **Example:** The vase fell off the table and is now broken.
 
 
 
• **Corrupt** (भ्रष्ट): Having or showing a willingness to act dishonestly in return for money or personal gain.
 
 
• **Example:** The corrupt official was finally arrested for taking bribes.
 
 
 
• **Firm** (मजबूत): Having a solid, almost unyielding surface or structure.
 
 
• **Example:** The mattress is firm enough to support your back properly.
